definitions.explanation: A white and gray seabird commonly seen at coasts and harbors.

examples.english: Seagulls are flying over the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧かもめ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are many seagulls at the harbor.
White seagulls were flying over the waves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ると→出る：00513_deru⟧、かもめ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}いかけてきた→追いかける：04628_oikakeru⟧。
examples.english: When the ship set out, seagulls chased after it.

notes:
かもめ (seagull/gull) is a common seabird seen at Japanese coastal areas, harbors, and beaches.

WRITING:
Can be written as ⟦{鷗|かもめ}→鷗：noentry⟧, though the kanji is uncommon and usually replaced by kana. The kanji is classified as ⟦{常用漢字外|じょうようかんじがい}→常用漢字外：noentry⟧ (outside the standard kanji list).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- かもめ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧: seagulls fly
- かもめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧: a flock of seagulls
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧かもめ: seagulls at the sea

CULTURAL NOTE:
かもめ appears frequently in Japanese literature, songs, and poetry as a symbol of the sea and coastal life. The famous play「かもめ」is the Japanese title for Chekhov's "The Seagull."

COUNTER:
Birds are counted with ⟦{羽|わ}→羽：noentry⟧: ⟦{一羽|いちわ}→一羽：23976_ichiwa⟧、⟦{二羽|にわ}→二羽：noentry⟧.
